title: Update Facebook social link URL

requirements.text: Update the site-wide Facebook profile URL to `https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61587955444489&name=xhp_nt__fb__action__open_user` by changing the `FACEBOOK_URL` constant in `frontend/src/content/socialLinks.ts`.
acceptanceCriteria: The Facebook icon link rendered in the footer uses the updated `FACEBOOK_URL` and opens the link in a new tab (target="_blank") without being treated as an invalid/disabled placeholder.

constraints: Do not modify any files under `frontend/src/hooks/*` listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Keep all changes within the existing React + TypeScript + Tailwind codebase; no new backend logic is required.
nonGoals: Do not change LinkedIn or X/Twitter URLs.
Do not redesign the footer or modify social-link validation behavior beyond what is necessary to reflect the updated Facebook URL.
